panels.title: Status
panels.description: Online if last_heartbeat_at within 2x timeframe. Offline = process may have stopped.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN last_heartbeat_at IS NULL THEN -1 WHEN last_heartbeat_at > now() - CASE UPPER(timeframe) WHEN 'H1' THEN interval '2 hours' WHEN '1H' THEN interval '2 hours' WHEN 'M5' THEN interval '10 minutes' WHEN '5M' THEN interval '10 minutes' WHEN 'M15' THEN interval '30 minutes' WHEN '15M' THEN interval '30 minutes' WHEN 'H4' THEN interval '8 hours' WHEN '4H' THEN interval '8 hours' WHEN 'D1' THEN interval '2 days' WHEN '1D' THEN interval '2 days' ELSE interval '2 hours' END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'

panels.title: Poll Seconds

targets.rawSql: SELECT poll_seconds AS "Seconds" FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id = '${run_id}'

panels.description: Polling interval in seconds. Only set for sim/live runs.

panels.title: Open Positions

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Count" FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol) symbol, remaining_quantity
  FROM trade_events
  WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'
  ORDER BY symbol, ts DESC
) p
WHERE p.remaining_quantity > 0

panels.description: Distinct symbols currently held. Pairs with Trades (closed count) next to it.

panels.title: Trades

targets.rawSql: SELECT trades FROM strategy_performance WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'

panels.description: Total closed trades (reduce + close). Low count (<30) = metrics statistically unreliable.

panels.title: Unrealized P&L
panels.description: Mark-to-market P&L across all open positions, shown as "$ / % of equity" — same figure as Position Snapshot's MTM P&L footer, computed live on every query. Total Return picks this up only as of its last refresh (close/reduce/funding, not per-bar — see its own note); between refreshes the two can diverge by exactly today's unrealized move, not double-counted profit. Backtest runs mark against the run's own ended_at, not a live price, so a finished run's number won't drift.

targets.rawSql:
WITH meta AS ( SELECT timeframe, data_source, mode, ended_at FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id='${run_id}'),
positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol) symbol, side, remaining_quantity, entry_price,
    notional / NULLIF(price * fill_quantity, 0) AS multiplier
  FROM trade_events
  WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'
  ORDER BY symbol, ts DESC
),
marks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.symbol) o.symbol, o.close AS mark
  FROM ohlcv o, meta m
  WHERE o.timeframe = m.timeframe
    AND (m.data_source IS NULL OR m.data_source = 'multi' OR o.data_source = m.data_source)
    AND o.ts <= CASE WHEN m.mode = 'backtest' THEN m.ended_at ELSE now() END
  ORDER BY o.symbol, o.ts DESC
),
pnl AS (
  SELECT SUM((CASE WHEN p.side='long' THEN mk.mark - p.entry_price
    ELSE p.entry_price - mk.mark END) * p.remaining_quantity * p.multiplier) AS value
  FROM positions p JOIN marks mk ON mk.symbol = p.symbol
  WHERE p.remaining_quantity > 0
),
equity AS (
  SELECT equity FROM equity_curve
  WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'
  ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  ROUND(pnl.value::numeric,0)::text || ' / ' ||
    ROUND((pnl.value/NULLIF(e.equity,0)*100)::numeric,1)::text || '%',
  'Flat'
) AS "Unrealized P&L"
FROM pnl CROSS JOIN equity e

panels.title: Margin Utilization
panels.description: Margin locked across open positions, shown as "$ / % of equity" — same quantity, two formats, not two different numbers (unlike Portfolio Exposure's notional %, this is capital actually committed, see that panel's description). Equals gross exposure for spot-only runs (margin_rate=1.0). Breakdown by financing regime (who set the rate — unlevered/fixed/dynamic) is in Margin Locked by Mode next to Portfolio Exposure; per-position detail is in Position Snapshot's Margin Mode column.

targets.rawSql:
WITH equity AS (
  SELECT equity FROM equity_curve
  WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'
  ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
),
positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol) symbol, remaining_quantity, margin_locked
  FROM trade_events
  WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'
  ORDER BY symbol, ts DESC
),
locked AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.margin_locked), 0) AS margin_locked
  FROM positions p WHERE p.remaining_quantity > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(l.margin_locked::numeric,0)::text || ' / ' ||
  ROUND((l.margin_locked/NULLIF(e.equity,0)*100)::numeric,1)::text || '%'
  AS "Margin Utilization"
FROM locked l CROSS JOIN equity e

panels.title: Total Return
panels.description: Compounded return over the full stored sample, shown as "$ / %". Not annualized. Net of cost. Realized-only: updates on close/reduce or funding, not every bar.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(net_pnl::numeric,0)::text || ' / ' ||
  ROUND((total_return*100)::numeric,1)::text || '%' AS "Total Return"
FROM strategy_performance
WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'

panels.title: Max Drawdown
panels.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline, shown as "$ / %". Always ≤ 0. The $ figure is live (equity_curve, updated every bar, includes unrealized swings); the % figure is realized-only (strategy_performance, updates on close/reduce/funding) — the two can diverge before the first close.

targets.rawSql:
WITH curve AS (
  SELECT equity, MAX(equity) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS peak
  FROM equity_curve
  WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'
),
dd AS (
  SELECT MAX(peak - equity) AS dollar_dd FROM curve
)
SELECT ROUND((-dd.dollar_dd)::numeric,0)::text || ' / ' ||
  ROUND((sp.max_drawdown*100)::numeric,1)::text || '%' AS "Max Drawdown"
FROM dd CROSS JOIN strategy_performance sp
WHERE sp.run_id = '${run_id}' AND sp.account_id = '${account_id}'

panels.title: Period Sharpe

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_sharpe FROM strategy_performance WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'

panels.description: Mean period return / sample period volatility. Not annualized; compare only like-frequency observations. Net of cost. Realized-only: updates on close/reduce or funding, not every bar.

panels.title: Period Sortino

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_sortino FROM strategy_performance WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'

panels.description: Mean period return / period downside deviation. Not annualized. Net of cost. Realized-only: updates on close/reduce or funding, not every bar.

panels.title: Win Rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT win_rate FROM strategy_performance WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'

panels.description: Winning trades (net_pnl > 0) / total trades. Read together with Profit Factor — low win rate + high profit factor means trend following. Realized-only: updates on close/reduce or funding, not every bar.

panels.title: Profit Factor

targets.rawSql: SELECT profit_factor FROM strategy_performance WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'

panels.description: Sum of winning net P&L / sum of losing net P&L. Blank if there are no losing trades yet. >1.5 healthy, <1.0 losing. Realized-only: updates on close/reduce or funding, not every bar.

panels.title: Portfolio Equity Curve
panels.description: Portfolio equity over time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, equity AS "Strategy" FROM equity_curve WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Trade Return Distribution
panels.description:
Realized return % per closed trade (reduce/close only), binned. Return
normalizes across position sizes, unlike raw P&L — trade-count based,
not time-based, so it stays readable for high-frequency strategies.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(net_return::numeric,4)::float8 AS "Return" FROM trade_events WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}' AND net_return IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Price Trend — ${symbol}
panels.description: Close price for the selected symbol, matched by timeframe and data source.

targets.rawSql: WITH meta AS ( SELECT timeframe, data_source, started_at, ended_at FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id = '${run_id}') SELECT o.ts AS time, o.close AS "${symbol}" FROM ohlcv o, meta m WHERE o.symbol = '${symbol}' AND o.timeframe = m.timeframe AND (m.data_source IS NULL OR m.data_source = 'multi' OR o.data_source = m.data_source) AND (m.started_at IS NULL OR o.ts >= m.started_at) AND (m.ended_at IS NULL OR o.ts <= m.ended_at) AND $__timeFilter(o.ts) ORDER BY o.ts

panels.title: Trade Events
panels.description:
One row per fill event, all symbols in the run — filter via the Symbol
column's icon. Lifecycle: open/add = entry, reduce/close = exit;
P&L/Notional Return/Margin Return only populate on reduce/close rows.

- `#` — row index.
- Time — event timestamp.
- Symbol — trading pair.
- Event — open / add / reduce / close.
- Side — long / short.
- Quantity — this event's fill size (base-asset units).
- Trade Price — this event's fill price.
- Cash Flow — net cash impact of this event, account currency:
  negative on open/add (capital deployed), positive on reduce/close
  (capital + PnL returned). Already nets out Cost — not another copy
  of it.
- P&L — realized profit/loss on this event, account currency
  (reduce/close only).
- Notional Return — price return, % of notional (reduce/close only).
- Margin Return — % return on the capital locked for the closed qty;
  = Notional Return for spot, amplified by leverage for futures.
- Margin Mode — who sets this side's margin rate: unlevered (spot/
  cash), fixed (exchange/regulator-set, e.g. TAIFEX margin or Reg-T),
  dynamic (trader-chosen leverage, e.g. isolated-margin perps). Same
  Leverage number means different things under each mode.
- Entry Price — weighted-average cost basis after this event, not
  this row's own Trade Price.
- Position — running position size after this event, not this
  event's Quantity.
- Cost — commission + slippage + tax for this event, account currency.
- Group — ties every leg of one atomic multi-leg decision (e.g. a
  spot+perp arb pair) — legs fill together or the group is rejected.
- Trade ID — symbol + this trade's open time; identifies one
  open→close round-trip.
- Periods — elapsed bars, not clock time — multiply by the run's
  timeframe for actual duration.
- Currency — account currency.
- Reason — free text, or one of 5 risk-exit codes: stop_loss,
  take_profit, liquidation, drawdown_breach, force_close.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS "#", ts AS "Time", symbol AS "Symbol", event_type AS "Event", side AS "Side", ROUND(fill_quantity::numeric,4) AS "Quantity", ROUND(price::numeric,2) AS "Trade Price", ROUND(cash_flow::numeric,2) AS "Cash Flow", ROUND(pnl::numeric,2) AS "P&L", ROUND(net_return::numeric,2) AS "Notional Return", ROUND(margin_roi::numeric,2) AS "Margin Return", margin_mode AS "Margin Mode", ROUND(entry_price::numeric,2) AS "Entry Price", ROUND(remaining_quantity::numeric,4) AS "Position", ROUND((commission + slippage + tax)::numeric,2) AS "Cost", group_id AS "Group", symbol || ' @ ' || to_char(entry_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Trade ID", periods_held AS "Periods", currency AS "Currency", reason AS "Reason" FROM trade_events WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Entry / Exit Signals — ${symbol}
panels.description: Signal decision time (1 period before fill). Entry = open/add, Exit = reduce/close.

targets.rawSql: SELECT te.ts - CASE UPPER(br.timeframe) WHEN 'H1' THEN interval '1 hour' WHEN '1H' THEN interval '1 hour' WHEN 'M5' THEN interval '5 minutes' WHEN '5M' THEN interval '5 minutes' WHEN 'M15' THEN interval '15 minutes' WHEN '15M' THEN interval '15 minutes' WHEN 'H4' THEN interval '4 hours' WHEN '4H' THEN interval '4 hours' WHEN 'D1' THEN interval '1 day' WHEN '1D' THEN interval '1 day' ELSE interval '1 hour' END AS time, te.price AS "Entry" FROM trade_events te JOIN backtest_runs br ON br.run_id = te.run_id WHERE te.run_id = '${run_id}' AND te.account_id = '${account_id}' AND te.symbol = '${symbol}' AND te.event_type IN ('open', 'add') AND $__timeFilter(te.ts)

SELECT te.ts - CASE UPPER(br.timeframe) WHEN 'H1' THEN interval '1 hour' WHEN '1H' THEN interval '1 hour' WHEN 'M5' THEN interval '5 minutes' WHEN '5M' THEN interval '5 minutes' WHEN 'M15' THEN interval '15 minutes' WHEN '15M' THEN interval '15 minutes' WHEN 'H4' THEN interval '4 hours' WHEN '4H' THEN interval '4 hours' WHEN 'D1' THEN interval '1 day' WHEN '1D' THEN interval '1 day' ELSE interval '1 hour' END AS time, te.price AS "Exit" FROM trade_events te JOIN backtest_runs br ON br.run_id = te.run_id WHERE te.run_id = '${run_id}' AND te.account_id = '${account_id}' AND te.symbol = '${symbol}' AND te.event_type IN ('reduce', 'close') AND $__timeFilter(te.ts)

panels.title: Position Snapshot
panels.description:
Holdings as of the time range's end (top-right picker) — one row per
symbol, sorted by |Weight| (biggest exposure first). Point-in-time
reconstruction, not an explicit rebalance list — drag the picker to a
past date to see positions as of that point instead.

- `#` — rank by |Weight|, largest exposure first.
- Time — this position's open time (entry_at).
- Symbol — trading pair.
- Side — long / short.
- Weight — position notional as % of equity, signed by side
  (negative = short).
- Entry Price — weighted-average cost basis across all fills to date.
- Position — current running size (base-asset units).
- Market Price — latest close at/before the picker's end time.
- MTM P&L — mark-to-market P&L at that time, account currency —
  not 'unrealized' in the live sense, a past date's position may
  since be closed.
- MTM Return — same, as % of Entry Price.
- Margin Locked — capital committed to this position, account
  currency (= notional for spot).
- Leverage — notional / Margin Locked (1.0 for spot).
- Margin Mode — who sets this side's margin rate: unlevered (spot/
  cash), fixed (exchange/regulator-set, e.g. TAIFEX margin or Reg-T),
  dynamic (trader-chosen leverage, e.g. isolated-margin perps). Same
  Leverage number means different things under each mode.
- Liquidation Price — price at which this position liquidates;
  null unless the market's maintenance_margin_rate is set.
- Liquidation Buffer — how far Market Price sits from Liquidation
  Price, % of Market Price; null under the same condition.
- Trade ID — symbol + this position's open time; filter it in Trade
  Events for the full fill history behind this row.

targets.rawSql:
WITH meta AS ( SELECT timeframe, data_source FROM backtest_runs WHERE run_id='${run_id}'),
equity AS (
  SELECT equity FROM equity_curve
  WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'
    AND ts <= $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
),
positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol) symbol, side, remaining_quantity,
    entry_price, entry_at, margin_locked, leverage, liquidation_price,
    margin_mode,
    notional / NULLIF(price * fill_quantity, 0) AS multiplier
  FROM trade_events
  WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'
    AND ts <= $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY symbol, ts DESC
),
marks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (o.symbol) o.symbol, o.close AS market_price
  FROM ohlcv o, meta m
  WHERE o.timeframe = m.timeframe
    AND (m.data_source IS NULL OR m.data_source = 'multi' OR o.data_source = m.data_source)
    AND o.ts <= $__timeTo()
  ORDER BY o.symbol, o.ts DESC
),
sized AS (
  SELECT p.symbol, p.side, p.remaining_quantity, p.entry_price, p.entry_at,
    p.margin_locked, p.leverage, p.liquidation_price, p.margin_mode,
    mk.market_price, p.multiplier,
    (CASE WHEN p.side='long' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END)
      * p.remaining_quantity * mk.market_price * p.multiplier AS signed_notional
  FROM positions p JOIN marks mk ON mk.symbol = p.symbol
  WHERE p.remaining_quantity > 0
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(s.signed_notional / NULLIF(e.equity,0)) DESC) AS "#",
  s.entry_at AS "Time",
  s.symbol AS "Symbol", s.side AS "Side",
  ROUND((s.signed_notional / NULLIF(e.equity,0))::numeric,4) AS "Weight",
  ROUND(s.entry_price::numeric,2) AS "Entry Price",
  ROUND(s.remaining_quantity::numeric,4) AS "Position",
  ROUND(s.market_price::numeric,2) AS "Market Price",
  ROUND(((CASE WHEN s.side='long' THEN s.market_price - s.entry_price
    ELSE s.entry_price - s.market_price END) * s.remaining_quantity * s.multiplier)    ::numeric,2) AS "MTM P&L",
  ROUND(((CASE WHEN s.side='long' THEN s.market_price - s.entry_price
    ELSE s.entry_price - s.market_price END) / NULLIF(s.entry_price,0))    ::numeric,4) AS "MTM Return",
  ROUND(s.margin_locked::numeric,2) AS "Margin Locked",
  ROUND(s.leverage::numeric,2) AS "Leverage",
  s.margin_mode AS "Margin Mode",
  ROUND(s.liquidation_price::numeric,2) AS "Liquidation Price",
  ROUND((CASE WHEN s.liquidation_price IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN s.side='long' THEN (s.market_price - s.liquidation_price) / NULLIF(s.market_price,0)
    ELSE (s.liquidation_price - s.market_price) / NULLIF(s.market_price,0) END)    ::numeric,4) AS "Liquidation Buffer",
  s.symbol || ' @ ' || to_char(s.entry_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Trade ID"
FROM sized s CROSS JOIN equity e
ORDER BY ABS(s.signed_notional / NULLIF(e.equity,0)) DESC

panels.title: Portfolio Exposure
panels.description: Gross/Net/Concentration as % of current equity — notional exposure, not margin usage. Concentration is whichever position is currently largest; it can shift between symbols, so check Position Snapshot to see which one.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, gross_exposure AS "Gross", net_exposure AS "Net", concentration AS "Concentration" FROM equity_curve WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Margin Locked by Mode
panels.description:
Current margin_locked across open positions, split by who sets the
rate (unlevered/fixed/dynamic — see Position Snapshot's Margin Mode
column), as % of equity. Same total as Margin Utilization, broken
down by composition instead of blended into one number — a fixed
(exchange-set) bar and a dynamic (self-chosen leverage) bar of equal
size carry very different headroom-to-add-risk implications.

targets.rawSql:
WITH equity AS (
  SELECT equity FROM equity_curve
  WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'
  ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
),
positions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol) symbol, remaining_quantity, margin_locked, margin_mode
  FROM trade_events
  WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND account_id = '${account_id}'
  ORDER BY symbol, ts DESC
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.margin_mode='unlevered' THEN p.margin_locked ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(MAX(e.equity),0) AS "Unlevered",
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.margin_mode='fixed' THEN p.margin_locked ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(MAX(e.equity),0) AS "Fixed",
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.margin_mode='dynamic' THEN p.margin_locked ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(MAX(e.equity),0) AS "Dynamic"
FROM positions p CROSS JOIN equity e
WHERE p.remaining_quantity > 0

panels.title: Runtime Events
panels.description:
Operational audit trail, not trade activity.

- `#` — row index.
- Time — event timestamp.
- Symbol — trading pair; blank for run-level events (state_recovered).
- Event — state_recovered (process resumed from checkpoint after a
  restart, sim/live only) or decision_skipped (a risk/sizing
  constraint blocked an order this period).
- Reason — why a decision was skipped, e.g. insufficient_cash,
  opposite_side, notional_capped; blank for state_recovered.
- Detail — full raw event payload behind Reason, for deeper checks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS "#", ts AS "Time", symbol AS "Symbol", event_type AS "Event", detail->>'reason' AS "Reason", detail::text AS "Detail" FROM runtime_events WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
